regime_context: China A-shares thematic tape is narrow and value-led: Banks hold a crowded, mixed-trend leadership with good breadth (0.722), while AI Compute & Optics is the lone credible challenger with clean trend but very thin breadth (0.176). The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's own history (gate_helps=false), so the detector's one validated edge is absent here — this is a focus-lens read, and track record (dir_accuracy 0.361 on 72 calls) says even directional leans have been poor; default to low conviction or fewer theses.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Semiconductors (512760.SS, rank 4, hurst 'trend', not crowded) closes the score gap with AI Compute & Optics to above 0.85 while keeping breadth above 0.3 — that would confirm a broadening of the tech leadership beyond the AI-names; until then it is just a non-crowded trend theme sitting mid-table.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the only eligible theme with clean trend texture (hurst_tag 'trend'), non-crowded positioning (crowding_z -0.56), and a rank just behind Banks. Given Banks is crowded (z 1.6, crowded=true) and this is NOT a one-narrative tape, a modest relative lean toward the cleaner-trend challenger is the most defensible conditional — but only as a trend continuation, not a prediction of handoff.
theses.dissent: Breadth is catastrophically thin at 0.176 — a handful of names carrying the theme; if those leaders stall, the whole basket rolls over fast. Also, momentum rank-IC is ~0 on this clean-sector universe, so rank 2 has no stand-alone edge.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead on momentum and breadth, but the theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.6) and has mixed trend texture (hurst_tag 'mixed'), plus r10 is slightly negative (-0.0216). On a gate_helps=false tape where the trend discipline whipsaws, chasing the crowded leader adds no validated edge — this is a sizing caution read, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Banks have the only genuine breadth in the tape — 0.722 means the whole group is participating. Fading or avoiding the widest, most-consistent theme in a mean-reverting, value-led A-share tape has historically been the documented failure mode (reflexivity).
